intro: Sanhoti Bengali Association hosts one of Orange County's most vibrant Durga Puja (Durgotsav) celebrations — three days of puja, pushpanjali, dhunuchi naach, Bengali food, and evening cultural concerts. Our Durgotsav 2025 was celebrated in Costa Mesa, CA, minutes from Irvine, Newport Beach, and Huntington Beach, welcoming Bengali and Indian families from across Southern California.
venueName: Estancia High School, 2323 Placentia Ave, Costa Mesa, CA 92627
venueNote: See this page for the full schedule and ticket information.

faqs.question: Where is Durga Puja celebrated in Orange County?
faqs.answer: Sanhoti Bengali Association hosts Durga Puja in central Orange County (2025: Costa Mesa, CA), an easy drive from Irvine, Tustin, Santa Ana, Anaheim, and Mission Viejo.

faqs.question: Is there a Durga Puja near Irvine?
faqs.answer: Yes — Sanhoti's Durga Puja is held minutes from Irvine, CA. The celebration includes puja, pushpanjali, dhunuchi naach, Bengali food, and cultural concerts.

faqs.question: Is Durga Puja open to non-members?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sanhoti Durga Puja is open to the entire community — families, students, and visitors from across Southern California are welcome.

faqs.question: When is Durga Puja in 2026?
faqs.answer: Durga Puja 2026 runs October 9–11. Sanhoti's celebration schedule will be announced on our Events page.
